purpose: Teach: 異国/もとづい/予知/相反/強硬/残虐/妊婦/修道院

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、異国の患者さんを医療チームでサポートしております
lines.en: Ren, we support our foreign patients through a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Opening with his name carries quiet authority. Steady pace, no rush. The tone of someone explaining something she's proud of to someone worth explaining to.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国際指針にもとづいた診療を、貴院、なさっておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital follows international guidelines for that diagnosis work, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost cautious respect. Slight upward inflection on the question — genuinely curious, not challenging. Careful articulation. The precision of someone thinking as he speaks.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、地震予知後の急患受け入れを医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes. We've prepared our team to handle emergency admissions after earthquake early warning.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. Each phrase lands clearly. No defensiveness, just information shared. A slight pause before the new thought, like she's considering what matters most to say.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療効果が相反する薬の組み合わせ、貴院、慎重ですね、先生
lines.en: The way your hospital handles drug combinations that might contradict each other — you're quite careful about that, aren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Not quite a statement, not quite a question. Leans slightly inward with interest. The careful phrasing of someone noticing something real and wanting to understand it better.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、強硬な治療より、寄り添う医療チームを目指します
lines.en: Yes. We believe in medicine that walks alongside the patient, rather than pushing aggressive treatment alone.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A slight slowing on the central thought. Her voice carries something deeply held — not preached, but genuinely believed. Calm and steady through to the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去の残虐な戦争被害者の医療記録を、貴院、保存されておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital preserves medical records from past war victims, from the atrocities — I noticed that.
lines.style: Very quiet, almost reverent. Slow pace. Deliberate word choice. Not accusatory or probing — more like bearing witness. Trails off slightly at the end, respecting the weight of what he's acknowledging.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、妊婦の健診を医療チームで丁寧に行います
lines.en: Yes. We conduct prenatal checkups with our team carefully, with real attention to each person.
lines.style: Warm but not soft. A slight emphasis on the care implied in the work itself. Measured, professional, but with something genuine underneath — not performing duty, but describing what actually happens.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、修道院との連携で福祉医療を進めておられますね、先生
lines.en: Through your partnership with the monastery, you're advancing medical care for people in need, aren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle and admiring. A slight lean forward in the voice — drawing closer. The question itself is almost an offering of understanding. Slow, deliberate, with warmth held close.
